description:
NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound intends to solicit and contract a firm fixed price, supply type contract for OEM Valve Temp Control with only one source, AMOT, on a Brand Name basis.

See attached solicitation for requirements. Solicitation closes on 17 March 2026 at 10:00 AM PDT. The Government anticipates awarding on or about 7 April 2026. All questions regarding this solicitation should be submitted to Vicktoria Wright, vicktoria.e.wright.civ@us.navy.mil.
